decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 24 Date 22 July 2018 Time 12:41 2018 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 23), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 5th Turbo Charger (TC), 5th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H), 4th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store (ES) and 3rd Control Electronics (CE) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 21st July, at 18:40
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 24 2018 German Grand Prix Offence Car 10 Power Unit Elements 0
